verdict.rationale: Lago runs one built-in recurring process: it automatically generates invoices on each plan's monthly or yearly cadence. Its Dunning Agent also automates chasing overdue invoices. Neither is shown to be a general facility for users or AI agents to schedule their own recurring jobs or workflows. Missing for 10: user-defined scheduled jobs or cron-style triggers, configurable workflow automation beyond fixed billing cycles, any API or agent action for creating schedules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
